import MumfordLib.SingularSmallChains
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Pseudo.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Bounded

/-!
# Geometric smallness for singular subdivision

Pulling an open cover back along a singular simplex gives a Lebesgue number
on its compact standard-simplex domain. Consequently, every reparametrization
whose image has sufficiently small diameter defines a small singular simplex.
This is the geometric input for subdivision, independently of the construction
of the subdivision chain map and its chain homotopy.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable (X : TopCat)

/-- Every singular simplex has a positive diameter bound such that all
reparametrizations with smaller image diameter are subordinate to the cover. -/
theorem singularSimplex_exists_small_diameter {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X)
    (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    {n : ℕ} (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ (m : ℕ)
      (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)), stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))),
      Metric.diam (Set.range f) < ε →
        (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋m⦌)).symm
          ((X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ).comp f) ∈
            (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).obj (op ⦋m⦌) := by
  let g := X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌) σ
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric
    (s := Set.univ) (c := fun i => g ⁻¹' U i) isCompact_univ
    (fun i => (hopen i).preimage g.continuous) (by
      intro t _
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover (g t)
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro m f hf
  let t₀ : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)) := Classical.arbitrary _
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hball (f t₀) (Set.mem_univ _)
  apply (mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_iff X U (op ⦋m⦌) _).2
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  intro t
  simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ContinuousMap.comp_apply]
  apply hi
  exact (Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem
    (isCompact_range f.continuous).isBounded
    (Set.mem_range_self t) (Set.mem_range_self t₀)).trans_lt hf

end Mumford.Analytic
